annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1698 of 9 October 2019 on European standards for products drafted in support of Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1698 of 9 October 2019 on European standards for products drafted in support of Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 259/65
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision publishing and withdrawing references of European standards under the General Product Safety Directive 2001/95/EC, covering consumer products such as gymnastic equipment, bicycles, cigarettes, training equipment, and child articles. Conformity confers presumption of safety. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I standard references are published in the Official Journal, giving presumption of safety.
Annex II references (e.g., EN 913:2008, EN 957 parts, EN 15649) are withdrawn.
Earlier decisions on standard publication are repealed and consolidated into one act.
Enters into force on the day of publication.
